scientific_inputs: Three fixed pairs in cases.json; unchanged original CVC2 ASTs and A7 seven-assumption envelope. No scientific input may change after prelaunch commit.
scope: Exact finite comparison under two explicitly named local observer profiles. Existing source evidence reused; new boundary serializations stay within the fixed Sort syntax and explicit ownership boundary.

selected_matrix.order: For each pair in cases.json, control before candidate, official then nanoda for each role. All successful cells run once. Four unused scientific launch slots do not authorize additional candidates.

execution: One root owner; commit exact manifest, inputs, source/runtime mapping, tool/test hashes and passing execution-control test evidence before begin-run; all artifact controls run inside the counted matrix. Reuse cvc_process with bounded Darwin signal_retry. Persist reservation before process, retain request/stdout/stderr/supervisor, hash receipts and replay ledger.

outcome_policy.accept: Exit 0 AND exact one-declaration success text AND empty stderr.
outcome_policy.refusal: Only explicit declared kernel type/ownership diagnostic or exact known Nanoda assertion+join diagnostic with bound returncode, after matched positive control. Unsupported ownership is not MODEL_INVALID.
outcome_policy.unexpected: Any other transcript is hypothesis mismatch/ERROR pending diagnosis, not automatic semantic rejection. Timeout, spawn, accounting and cleanup faults pause all launches; charge failed reservations.
outcome_policy.model_relative: Official refusal of E-POS demonstrates that this finite acceptance obligation is not supplied by this observer; no invalid accepted proof or universal defect claim follows.

repair: Engineering revisions stay under this item and all cumulative charges. Preserve old exact manifest/tooling/receipts and frozen cases. Never reinterpret old failures with a new parser. Reconciliation requires raw receipts and current process absence. A scientific change requires a durable boundary decision.

nanoda_profile.base: Pinned historical Arena binary and semantic options.
changes: use_stdin=false and export_file_path points to the exact committed input file; both use the same BufRead parser.
print_success_message=true requires explicit confirmation that exactly one declaration was checked.
nanoda_profile.scope: New local transport/diagnostic profile, not an unchanged historical run; no constants or input axioms.

runtime.binary_linkage: otool -L: official links /usr/lib/libc++.dylib and /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib; Nanoda links /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib. No external Lean shared-library dependency in the selected executables. OS loader/hardware and build-source correspondence remain trusted.

administrative_fixture_budget.prelaunch_tests: Pure/mocked runner and byte-binding tests, plus reuse of exact unchanged source-bound process controls and prior passing full suite.
administrative_fixture_budget.closure: Required full current/historical suite with instrumented original fixture ledgers. Each suite reserves before launch. No repeat without material change/failure and reconciliation. Separate from scientific allowance.

stop: Stop at completed fixed matrix or real scope/cap/authority boundary. Close this single item, select but do not begin a useful next item, commit and push main.
